cards.ex: I found this amazing vintage lamp at the flea market downtown.
cards.exUz: Men shahar markazidagi arzon bozordan ajoyib eski chiroq topdim.
cards.uzDef: Eski va arzon narsalar sotiladigan ochiq joydagi bozor.

cards.ex: Our real estate agent was really helpful in finding our dream home.
cards.exUz: Rieltorimiz orzudagi uyimizni topishda juda yordam berdi.
cards.uzDef: Uy-joy sotish yoki ijaraga berish bilan shug'ullanuvchi odam.

cards.ex: We're planning to move into our new apartment next month.
cards.exUz: Kelasi oy yangi kvartiramizga ko'chib o'tmoqchimiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi uyga yoki kvartiraga yashash uchun ko'chib o'tish.

cards.ex: The rent is a bit higher, but it's utilities included, so it evens out.
cards.exUz: Ijara biroz qimmatroq, lekin kommunal xizmatlar ichida, shuning uchun tenglashadi.
cards.uzDef: Ijara narxiga elektr, suv, gaz kabi xizmatlar kiradi.

cards.ex: We're throwing a housewarming party next weekend to celebrate our new place.
cards.exUz: Kelgusi hafta oxirida yangi uyimizni nishonlash uchun uy to'yi qilamiz.
cards.uzDef: Yangi uyga ko'chib o'tgandan keyin uy egalari tomonidan tashkil etiladigan bayram.

cards.ex: The hotel is located right in the heart of the city.
cards.exUz: Mehmonxona shahar markazida joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Biror joyning eng asosiy va gavjum qismida joylashgan.

cards.ex: After a long day at work, I just want some peace and quiet.
cards.exUz: Ishdagi uzoq kundan keyin men faqat tinchlik va osoyishtalikni xohlayman.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar va shovqindan uzoqda bo'lgan tinch holat.

cards.ex: The store gets a lot of foot traffic because it's near the subway station.
cards.exUz: Do'kon metro bekati yaqinida bo'lgani uchun ko'p piyodalar harakati bor.
cards.uzDef: Biror joydan o'tadigan piyodalar soni.

cards.ex: The beach is just a stone's throw from our apartment.
cards.exUz: Plyaj kvartiramizdan juda yaqin joylashgan.
cards.uzDef: Juda yaqin masofada joylashgan, oson yetib borish mumkin.

cards.ex: The city has a vibrant nightlife scene with lots of bars and clubs.
cards.exUz: Shaharda ko'plab bar va klublar bilan jonli kechki hayot bor.
cards.uzDef: Shahar yoki hududdagi barlar, klublar va boshqa kechki ko'ngil ochish joylari.

cards.ex: My new roommate and I got on like a house on fire.
cards.exUz: Mening yangi xonadoshim bilan biz tezda do'stlashib ketdik.
cards.term: get on like a house on fire
cards.uzDef: Bir-biri bilan tezda yaxshi munosabatda bo'lish, do'stlashib ketish.

cards.ex: Adding some flowers and painting the door can really improve curb appeal.
cards.exUz: Ba'zi gullar qo'shish va eshikni bo'yash uyning tashqi ko'rinishini yaxshilaydi.
cards.uzDef: Uyning ko'chadan ko'rinadigan tashqi jozibadorligi.

cards.ex: The city is trying to combat urban decay by investing in the neglected areas.
cards.exUz: Shahar qarovsiz qolgan hududlarga sarmoya kiritish orqali shahar tanazzuliga qarshi kurashmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Shaharning bir qismi buzilishi, eskirishi va yaroqsiz holga kelishi.

cards.ex: We bought a starter home so we could start building equity.
cards.exUz: Biz kapital to'plashni boshlash uchun boshlang'ich uy sotib oldik.
cards.uzDef: Birinchi marta uy sotib olayotganlar uchun mo'ljallangan kichik uy.

cards.ex: We live in a large apartment complex with a swimming pool and a gym.
cards.exUz: Bizda suzish havzasi va sport zali bo'lgan katta turar joy majmuasida yashaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir nechta kvartiralardan iborat bo'lgan katta bino yoki binolar guruhi.

cards.ex: We grow our own vegetables in the community garden.
cards.exUz: Biz o'z sabzavotlarimizni jamoat bog'ida yetishtiramiz.
cards.uzDef: Mahalliy aholi uchun o'simliklar yetishtirish uchun mo'ljallangan bog'.

cards.ex: The old factory was demolished and the brownfield site is being redeveloped.
cards.exUz: Eski fabrika buzildi va sanoat zonasi qayta qurilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Ilgari sanoat uchun ishlatilgan va ifloslangan yer.

cards.ex: Our house has been on the market for three months, but we haven't had any offers.
cards.exUz: Uyimiz uch oydan beri sotuvda, lekin hech qanday taklif bo'lmadi.
cards.uzDef: Sotilishi e'lon qilingan, sotuvga qo'yilgan.

cards.ex: The new mixed-use development will bring more jobs and housing to the area.
cards.exUz: Yangi aralash qurilish hududga ko'proq ish o'rinlari va uy-joy olib keladi.
cards.uzDef: Turar joy, savdo va ofis binolari birga joylashgan loyiha.

cards.ex: That abandoned building is such an eyesore in the neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Ushbu tashlandiq bino mahallada juda xunuk ko'rinadi.
cards.uzDef: Atrofga xunuk ko'rinish beruvchi bino yoki joy.

cards.ex: People often live beyond their means when they are trying to keep up with the Joneses.
cards.exUz: Odamlar ko'pincha qo'shnilardan qolmaslik uchun imkoniyatdan ortiq yashaydilar.
cards.uzDef: Daromaddan ko'ra ko'proq pul sarflash.

cards.ex: The city is undergoing a major urban renewal project.
cards.exUz: Shahar katta shahar yangilanishi loyihasini boshdan kechirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Eski shaharlarni qayta qurish va yaxshilash jarayoni.

cards.ex: We live in a tight-knit community where everyone looks out for each other.
cards.exUz: Biz hammamiz bir-biriga g'amxo'rlik qiladigan ahil qo'shnilar bilan yashaymiz.
cards.uzDef: Bir-biriga yaqin va doimiy yordam beradigan odamlardan iborat jamoa.

cards.ex: We rely on public transportation to get around the city.
cards.exUz: Biz shaharda harakatlanish uchun jamoat transportiga tayanmiz.
cards.uzDef: Avtobuslar, tramvaylar, metro va boshqa odamlarni tashish uchun mo'ljallangan transport tizimi.

cards.ex: Many people commute to the city from the surrounding bedroom communities.
cards.exUz: Ko'p odamlar atrofidagi uyqu tumanlaridan shaharga qatnaydi.
cards.uzDef: Aholisi asosan boshqa joyda ishlaydigan turar-joy hududi.

cards.ex: I ran to the corner store to buy some milk.
cards.exUz: Men sut sotib olish uchun kichik do'konga yugurdim.
cards.uzDef: Ko'cha burchagida joylashgan kichik oziq-ovqat do'koni.

cards.ex: Gentrification is changing the character of the neighborhood.
cards.exUz: Obodonlashtirish mahallaning xarakterini o'zgartirmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Arzon hududlarda boy odamlar joylashishi natijasida narxlar oshishi.

cards.ex: Having more residents walking around provides 'eyes on the street' and deters crime.
cards.exUz: Ko'proq aholi ko'chada yurishi 'ko'cha xavfsizligini' ta'minlaydi va jinoyatchilikning oldini oladi.
cards.uzDef: Odamlar ko'chada bo'lganida, ular xavfsizlikni ta'minlaydi.

cards.ex: She moved mountains to get the new community center built.
cards.exUz: U yangi jamoat markazini qurish uchun juda katta harakat qildi.
cards.uzDef: Juda katta harakat qilib, qiyin narsaga erishmoq.

cards.ex: It's a landlord's market right now, so rents are very high.
cards.exUz: Hozir ijarachilar bozori, shuning uchun ijaralar juda yuqori.
cards.uzDef: Ijara uy-joylariga talab yuqori, taklif kam bo'lgan bozor.
